'''Tonheld Mining Corporation''' was a mining company that held exclusive rights to mine the [[asteroid field]]s of the [[Halmad system/Legends|Halmad system]] during the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The company's headquarters was located on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[A3]] at [[Site A3]]. After efficiently hollowing out the asteroids around [[36 ABY]], the company abandoned the asteroid field. Many years later, [[Wraith Squadron]] used Site A3 as a staging point for their [[Hawk-bat Base|base]] when posing as the [[Hawk-bat Independent Space Force|Hawk-bats]].
